method: Assistant visual inspection of six contact sheets decoded from the final MP4; sampled review, not manual inspection of every frame.
notes: Close shot in chapter 1 reframed to exclude a cropped supporting actor.
Chapter 3 re-rendered with synchronized cube translation, fixed hand targets and clearance for legs/hips.
Flights and zero-gravity scenes keep the focal action visible.
All six station transitions use the intended pale fade; no unexpected blank frame in sampled action shots.
Chapter 6 includes bridge deployment, coordinated controls, final orb gag and fade.
